summary: Rubico Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching press releases announcing the termination of a $30 million common stock purchase agreement (equity line of credit) with B. Riley Principal Capital II, LLC, originally entered July 21, 2025. Approximately $27.1 million of common shares had been sold under the agreement. The termination is a routine corporate action; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, incorporating the press releases by reference. No deal terms, premiums, or structural changes are present, and no risk-arb angle applies.
